scenes.caption: “괜찮아?”
scenes.say: “괜찮아?” 하고 물으면, 우리는 늘 “응, 괜찮아.” 해요.
그런데 그 ‘괜찮아’ 안에는 서운함도, 긴장도, 피곤함도 숨어 있어요.

scenes.caption: 마음에도 날씨와 기온이 있다면
scenes.clipPrompt: Keep the exact flat hand-drawn illustration style, colors and line art. Static camera. The red line inside the big thermometer slowly rises toward the flame and then sinks back toward the ice. The small cloud and raindrops beside it drift gently, the little flame flickers, and the boy looking up at the thermometer tilts his head curiously and touches his chest with one hand. Subtle natural movements, no new characters, no numbers, no text, the empty area stays empty.

scenes.caption: 정확한 단어 하나
scenes.say: 정확한 단어 하나가, 나를 돕는 첫걸음이 돼요.
오늘은 ‘괜찮아’ 말고, 내 마음의 진짜 단어를 찾아봐요.
